samples.xml_description:
<module id="pe">
    <description>Implement a Multiplying Accumulator for 32bit integer. In the MAC_PE, there is a register that stores the partial sum (the intermediate accumulation result), and in each cycle, the result of “a multiplied by b” will be accumulated in this register, and the “c” shows the value of the register.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock.</input>
        <input id="rst">Reset.</input>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">Input A.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Input B.</input>
        <output id="c" width_description="[31:0]">Output C.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <enum id="state_0" value="0">State 0.</enum>
        <enum id="state_1" value="1">State 1.</enum>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="c" type="wire" width_description="[31:0]">Output C.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Implement a Multiplying Accumulator for 32bit integer. In the MAC_PE, there is a register that stores the partial sum (the intermediate accumulation result), and in each cycle, the result of “a multiplied by b” will be accumulated in this register, and the “c” shows the value of the register.</implementation>
</module>
